correctness.rationale: Encoding each circular-ladder rung by a 2-bit mask yields a 16-state pair transfer T with triple-mask admissibility iff induced selected degree<=1, so D_n(z)=tr T(z)^n for n>=3. Independently rebuilt T and computed all 16 Newton characteristic coefficients at 33 integer z values 0..32, verifying det(I-uT)=Q(u,z) exactly: each coefficient has z degree <=32, hence equality at 33 points is an algebraically exhaustive polynomial identity. Log determinant gives full all-n rational generating formula and recurrence. A double-selected rung forces two adjacent empties, proving |S|<=n. At equality either every rung is singleton with cyclic binary layers avoiding constant triples (OEIS A007040) or even n alternates empty/double rung (two extra configurations). Hence max count L_n+3*1_{3|n}-1+2*1_{2|n}. Independent brute-force all subsets n=3..8 matched all coefficients and maxima.
residual_risks: Formal transfer formula assumes n>=3; n=3 horizontal neighbors distinct.
Exact finite algebraic characteristic certificate supports infinite recurrence; bounded subset tests alone would not.
